This Veterans Day, we honor the brave men and women who have worn our nation’s uniform and the families who have stood beside them.

To all who have served and continue to serve, thank you. God bless our veterans and God bless America. https://t.co/uEG8gZTpae
World Series champs! Congratulations to the 2026 champions. 🏆 #WinOurWay https://t.co/qh1hrRVcGH

Serving our country is a commitment that extends beyond the uniform, and we owe it to our Veterans and their families to support them every step of the way.

I’m proud to work with my friend and fellow Veteran, @RepDonDavis, on the bipartisan Hire Our Heroes Act to help Veterans https://t.co/PBxd0aUXUL

Great to welcome @SecretaryWright to #WI03 and Dairyland Power to highlight the importance of coal in strengthening American energy independence and securing our energy future.

The Trump Administration is investing $19 million to modernize Alliant Energy’s Columbia Energy https://t.co/tuJUHCBQW5

“Van Orden showed the two Trump Cabinet members just how businesses in his backyard are helping to build America’s Arsenal of Freedom…Van Orden, himself a former Navy SEAL, added that ‘our awesome manufacturers are keeping America safe and the world free by working every day.’” @DC_Reporter 

https://t.co/MKYfMq2n0o

I joined 3M, Prairie du Chien High School students, and local educators to celebrate the new Future Makers Lab, giving students hands-on experience in manufacturing, skilled trades, and other careers that will keep Wisconsin moving forward.

We need more opportunities like this to help the next generation build skills, find good-paying jobs, and succeed right here in #WI03 

Thanks to 3M and everyone who made this investment in our students possible!

Thank you to the Coalition Against MariBell for bringing Wisconsinites together to stand up for our home.

These are our communities, our farmland, and our neighbors who will live with the consequences of these projects. I’ve taken the fight against the proposed MariBell and BECI 765-kV transmission lines all the way to the Cabinet level, and I’m calling for a moratorium on both.

Wisconsin deserves to have its voice heard.

Great to visit First Supply’s Poehling Distribution Innovation Center in West Salem!

This fifth-generation, family-owned Wisconsin business has been serving customers since 1897 and now employs nearly 800 people across five states.

Proud to see Wisconsin businesses investing in innovation, creating jobs, and keeping our communities strong.

Insurance companies and brokers profited while taxpayers were left footing the bill for nearly 200,000 duplicate enrollments.

That’s BILLIONS in taxpayer dollars wasted.

It is absolutely UNACCEPTABLE that hardworking Wisconsinites are being forced to foot the bill for this kind of waste.

Democrats are crying about “cuts” that crack down on this abuse. Taxpayers deserve accountability.

Back in Cuba City, WI at sixth-generation Tranel Family Farms alongside @epaleezeldin and State Rep. Travis Tranel

We discussed President Trump’s EPA work to reverse DEF deratements, restore Right to Repair, and bring common sense back to environmental regulations so Wisconsin farmers can focus on what they do best.

Congratulations to the 14 graduates of Western Technical College’s Law Enforcement Academy!

It was an honor to deliver the keynote address and recognize these men and women as they begin their careers protecting our communities. Wisconsin is in good hands with the next generation of law enforcement officers.

I joined CHS in Evansville on Wednesday to break ground on a new 80-million-bushel soybean processing facility that will create new market opportunities for our farmers and strengthen America’s agricultural supply chain. https://t.co/cOrQAonuEa

Wisconsin is the nation’s #1 cranberry-producing state, and farms like DuBay Cranberry Co. are a big part of that tradition.

I enjoyed touring their 160-acre marsh in Junction City with Dave Hansen, who spent 32 years managing the operation. DuBay produces 4 million pounds of cranberries each year. Thanks to Dave for showing us firsthand how Wisconsin growers get it done!

Stopped by the Reyes Coca-Cola Bottling facility in La Crosse to see firsthand how they keep Wisconsin stocked with everyone’s favorite drinks.

With about 55 employees at this facility, their work keeps products moving and shelves stocked across the region. Thanks to the Reyes team for the warm welcome and for showing us what it takes to keep things running every day.

I’m honored to be in Wisconsin Rapids today to break ground on the new Family Health Center that will bring dental and other healthcare services closer to home!

Our office worked with Senator Tammy Baldwin’s office to secure $3 million in federal funding for this project. This investment is a great example of what we can accomplish when we work together to get things done for Wisconsin.

I’m proud to see this investment come back to the people of Wisconsin Rapids to help our families, veterans, seniors, and children receive high quality and readily available care right here at home.

From small shops to major manufacturers, Wisconsin workers are building the equipment, products, and machinery that keep our economy moving.

I’m proud to represent the hardworking and skilled men and women who make things right here in Wisconsin. We have the finest workers and manufacturers in the country.

Happy National Manufacturing Day!

I didn’t come to Congress to get rich. I came to serve the people of #WI03.

I voted to ban congressional stock trading. I’ve never bought or traded a single stock. Congress should be about serving the American people, not getting rich off the job. https://t.co/0YGyMOfDRr

I recently met with Wisconsin auto and truck dealers!

I’m proud to cosponsor the REPAIR Act and will work to protect Wisconsinites’ Right to Repair.

We also discussed the Connected Vehicle Security Act and strengthening cybersecurity for today’s increasingly connected vehicles.

Appreciate Chad, Josh, Bill, and Chris making the trip to D.C. and bringing Wisconsin’s perspective to the table.

🚧 In Congress, I’ve worked to bring over $19.6 MILLION for roads, transportation and critical infrastructure across our district.

I’m fighting to make sure your tax dollars work for you here in #WI03, not get swallowed up by some random bureaucratic black hole in Washington. https://t.co/9dqOaTWfzi

I’m down in Richland Center today talking with residents and local leaders to hear directly from folks who will be affected by these proposed transmission lines.

Last week, I asked Governor Evers, in good faith, to put a moratorium on BECI and MariBell until the serious concerns of affected landowners, farmers, and communities are addressed. Instead, he pointed to a bureaucracy and washed his hands of it.

That isn’t good enough for any of us. We are not going to give up our homes because Tony Evers is too cowardly to lead. I’m going to keep fighting for the people who call the Driftless home.

Last week, we got down to some serious turkey business!

I met with West Liberty Foods to talk about Wisconsin’s turkey growers and the issues affecting them, from animal health and the ag workforce to trade.

I’m always glad to hear directly from the folks who keep Wisconsin Ag moving.

If you own a farm tractor, motorcycle, lawn mower or other equipment, you ought to be able to fix it yourself without having to jump through hoops or pay a manufacturer because they locked you out of your own equipment.

That's why I support the REPAIR Act.

https://t.co/ZQKvw5Qhgq

I am proud to earn an A+ on NSSF’s 2026 Congressional Report Card for standing up for the Second Amendment, the firearm industry, and Wisconsin’s law-abiding gun owners

https://t.co/kaY7xwSHrE

“Van Orden highlighted the Right to Equitable and Professional Auto Industry Repair (REPAIR) Act, legislation he co-sponsors that aims to give consumers and independent repair shops access to the data, tools and information needed to make repairs.”

https://t.co/i5RYnDaDVf

I’m in Holmen this morning meeting with independent repair shop owners and ABATE Wisconsin to discuss the REPAIR Act.

Farmers, small businesses, and Wisconsin consumers all deserve the right to repair the equipment and vehicles they own without being forced to rely on manufacturers.

I’m proud to be a co-sponsor of the REPAIR Act and a champion for your right to repair! #WI03

Congressman Derrick Van Orden released the following statement on @GovEvers response to his letter calling for a moratorium on the proposed BECI and MariBell 765-kV transmission lines through Wisconsin’s Driftless Region, claiming he cannot do anything about the projects. 

Read Van Orden’s full statement below.

“The reason a PSC exists is so politicians can hide behind bureaucrats.

Governor Evers appointed all three members of the Public Service Commission. Every single one. So when Tony Evers says he has no ability to influence what happens, Wisconsin taxpayers deserve to know why he is pretending to be powerless when the people making these decisions are his own appointees.

You can’t put a mailbox in the ground without going through the DNR, yet Tony Evers would have Wisconsin believe that nothing can be done to protect the Driftless Region from massive transmission lines being forced through communities that do not want them.

Tony Evers has already authorized a 400-year property tax increase on Wisconsin families, but now claims his hands are tied when it comes to protecting the Driftless Region. After wielding the power of his office to raise costs on Wisconsin taxpayers for generations, he suddenly wants us to believe he is powerless. I call bullshit.

We asked Governor Evers in good faith to stand up for the Driftless Region. Instead, he pointed to a bureaucracy and washed his hands of it.

We will not give up the Driftless Region because Tony Evers is too cowardly to lead. Hell no.”

Today, I sent @GovEvers a letter urging him to use his executive authority to immediately enact a moratorium on the proposed BECI and MariBell 765-kV transmission lines through Wisconsin’s Driftless Region.

I’ve heard directly from the landowners, farmers, and communities who would be impacted by these projects.

Before these massive transmission corridors move forward, we need answers about their impact on agriculture, property, the environment, and our groundwater.

#WI03 families deserve to have these concerns fully addressed before their land and communities are permanently impacted.

“Van Orden sent a letter to Evers asking for a moratorium on the proposed BECI and MariBell transmission lines until concerns from affected landowners, farmers and communities are addressed.”

https://t.co/YXb1JkVY8Z

I just voted YES on the Ratepayer Protection Act.

Wisconsin families shouldn’t be stuck paying higher utility bills to subsidize massive energy demands, including from data centers. This bill protects Wisconsin families and makes sure the costs of powering our growing economy don’t get dumped on us here in #WI03.

I won’t let big corporations squeeze our hardworking families for their gain.
Praise be to God! https://t.co/SWVvVahQpP
